newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady, market becalmed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady, market becalmed.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady on Tuesday but the market was becalmed, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded in the morning at $192 a tonne fob ARA and no business was heard done since then, although offers were pegged as high as $195.50 a tonne late in the day.
July swaps changed hands at around $187 a tonne.
"It is so very quiet," one dejected trader said.
Arbitrage numbers to the United States were not considered viable.
MTBE was quiet, too, and bids and offers were pegged at around $270/$275.
